description: This file is a Python script that sets up a live audio pipeline using the Pipecat framework, integrating LiveKit for transport and Cartesia TTS for text-to-speech services. It defines an asynchronous main function to configure and run a pipeline, handles events for participant joining, and speaks a greeting message.

classes.name: LiveKitTransport
classes.description: Transport class for LiveKit audio streaming, configured with URL, token, room name, and parameters, and capable of handling events.

classes.name: CartesiaTTSService
classes.description: Text-to-speech service implementation using Cartesia API, initialized with an API key and voice ID.

classes.name: PipelineRunner
classes.description: Class responsible for executing defined processing pipelines asynchronously.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Represents a task consisting of a sequence of pipeline components to execute.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: A sequence of processing steps (components like TTS and transport output) forming a communication pipeline.

classes.name: TTSSpeakFrame
classes.description: Frame representing text-to-speech content to be spoken by the system.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Asynchronous main function that configures the livekit transport, TTS service, creates pipeline and runner, registers event handlers, and runs the pipeline.

methods.name: on_first_participant_joined(transport, participant_id)
methods.description: Event handler that triggers when the first participant joins; it waits briefly then sends a greeting message via TTS.
